name: PearlDriver NLAMM unchecked buy() cost overflow
summary: NLAMM.buy(token,index,amount) runs inside an unchecked block and charges amount * currentPrice in USDT, then mints amount * 1e18 game tokens. Choosing amount so the product wraps let the attacker pay fractions of a cent for up to 1e63 tokens of five craft resources, which it sold into their PearlDEX USDT pairs in the same transaction; two later actors repeated the overflow before the implementation was replaced.

loss.notes: USDT paid out of PearlDEX pairs (factory 0x73a0ba8bac1b6ae00de1e9cf767cdb98075ab92e) for overflow-minted tokens, per campaign; no USDT flowed into those pairs from the attackers in these transactions. The fractional USDT paid to NLAMM for the mints is attacker input and is not subtracted. BSC-USD valued at par.

ageReset.description: ProxyAdmin 0xf07fe21037556a27a33a0662a49373f1a3bb092d upgrade (0x99a88ec4) by 0xbc9d5a23f2e55286650aae5573c524703aeb4724 replaced the initial implementation 0x5bb5e880479b3a39b10baf04f724e1d8ceb2021e with NLAMM 0x1903d672; the next upgrade (block 82160602) came after the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age history. Verified NLAMM source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=56 for 0x1903d672, v0.8.28+commit.7893614a, optimizer 200; SHA-256 of SourceCode 986cc436e0fd0c975e8a0bffd677525639440d6c2b9ea97f24615003aa7d9239), contracts/nlamm/NLAMM.sol buy(): the whole body is `unchecked`; safeTransferFrom(stablecoin, msg.sender, this, amount * currentPrice) and then mintERC20(token, msg.sender, amount * E18). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 82115373, index 49, contract creation by EOA 0xdbca72816b83a60f5ca7cf93a1420c6e7b215aca -> 0x23e5de4a390702b1ff6da7fd0b0f17b79f8eee1a): five rounds of buy (0xa59ac6dd via the proxy's delegatecall to 0x1903d672) on craft tokens 0x26c97005..., 0x40037b75..., 0x414ef9a6..., 0xee4b91dc..., 0xe9456f10... paying 0.005319, 0.001053, 0.001046, 0.0000996 and 0.002492 USDT, each followed by a PearlDEX router 0x73a0ba8b swapExactTokensForTokens (0x38ed1739) into that token's USDT pair. First exercise: eth_getLogs on the proxy (blocks 79617604..82200000) returns 57 Buy events; decoding (token,index,amount,basePrice,targetPrice,currentPrice), amount*currentPrice < 2^256 for all 48 before source-1 (amounts 1..10000); the first wrapping purchases are the five in source-1, followed by 0x2db1ab08 (blocks 82117789, 82118982, 82124169) and 0x9c862444 (82142171). Age: Upgraded logs on the proxy are 79617604 (creation, 0x5bb5e880), source-2 (block 79644556, index 27, log 68, topic1 0x1903d672) and 82160602 (0x1c36a15b, post-exploit fix). The EIP-1967 implementation slot reads 0x5bb5e880 at 79644555 and 0x1903d672 at 79644556 and 82115372. Implementation 0x1903d672 is a top-level creation (source-11, block 79637029, index 88, by 0x17d5b07a0e6028edb638eb0a94c12ef7c73bcedb); eth_getCode is 0x at 79637028 and keccak256 0xf88fa047e5bcf1b480f878a6bcdda0125133bf7d116363325542f025b4254216 at 79637029 and 82115372. Proxy (TransparentUpgradeableProxy, runtime keccak256 0x2bc0a664d69e46853565b221e1ae2ecd70f6abf9d946b569980f2bf98fc8983b at 79617604 and 82115372, empty at 79617603) is created top-level by the same EOA in source-9 (index 89). Token registration (addToken, onlyRolesOrOwner(CONFIG_OPERATOR_ROLE), no event) only makes a token purchasable; the overflow is generic to every registered token, so registration is ordinary wiring and the implementation upgrade supplies the age.

Reviewed loss. Pairs are identified by factory() == 0x73a0ba8bac1b6ae00de1e9cf767cdb98075ab92e. Source-1 receipt USDT transfers from pairs to 0x23e5de4a: log 212 0x9849e6828022e8b5161cd5c70f4bf38eaf78cfde 7805558224390563581443, log 222 0x3119b2f98693a333394c2e68c0b31dcde7183dae 8337144257673105534613, log 232 0xb38d61552658bacdb382bb3074c104e0a2060ed0 9541691613786665270666, log 242 0xf5784cbdd3d64dbdf882fd9f5b89109793e9f7e6 6468134888472375307607, log 252 0x9095d1083a19be8e390536e9acaf5d4080ce87aa 8182972560290464373034; sum 40335.501544613174067363 USDT (the 6.05 USDT from PancakeSwap pair 0x16b9a828 is the attacker's own BNB swap and is excluded).
